prompt:
Work in this folder.

Part `answer-from-code`: read the code in `answer-from-code/`. What port does the server listen on when no environment variable or flag says otherwise? Write just the number into `answer-from-code/answer.txt`.

Part `edit-json` depends on `answer-from-code`: first read `answer-from-code/answer.txt` and copy its contents into `edit-json/PORT.txt`. Then, in `edit-json/package.json`, add an npm script named `lint` that runs `eslint .`, and raise the version's patch number by one. Change nothing else in `edit-json/package.json`.

The parts are otherwise independent.
